replies.body:
Heeya c4ooo,

Thank you for the report!
Since it's his first offence for being Vulgar/Rude, he only gets a warn, but as you know the punishment increases if he does it again.
(I also requested a logcheck, so if he spammed the punishment will be more harsh, since he already has 2 infractions for it.)
Regarding the spleefing, we need video evidence to take actions/punish.

Reviewing until the logs are checked.

Regards Flo/resepignev
